dataset_source: A public dataset on long-distance running training in 2019 and 2020
outcome_definition: Jul–Dec 2019 mean pace (min/km) <= Jan–Jun 2019 mean pace * 0.95 (at least 5% faster)
leakage_controls: Features use only weeks with datetime <= 2019-06-30
H2 distance and pace are label-only; never encoded as features
Eligibility requires distance>0 in both halves so pace is defined

sample_count.major_column_usage: EXCLUDED — retrospective profile tag, not a future label
sample_count.leakage_note: Features use only weeks with datetime <= 2019-06-30; H2 distance/pace are labels only

known_limitations: Pace from weekly aggregates (duration/distance); not race-certified times
5% threshold is a product goal proxy, not a physiology claim
Athletes who stop logging in H2 are excluded (distance>0 filter)
